profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Metis Technology Solutions, Inc.
profile.summary: Over 35 years of experience in the design and implementation of real-time and embedded software and hardware systems. Extensive knowledge of military software development standards and practices, including the use of software configuration management tools. Experience with real and simulated avionics and electronic warfare systems. Experience maintaining software systems for a wide variety of fixed-wing (F/A-18, A-7, MC-130P) and rotary-wing (MH-53J, HH-60G, MH-47E, MH-60K/L) flight simulators. Broad knowledge of low and high level programming languages, development environments, and target systems. Active DoD Secret clearance.

positions.title: Associate Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently assigned to support the NASA RSES contract. Air Traffic Operations Simulation (ATOS). ATOS Responsibilities include the development and enhancement of the Airspace and Traffic Operations Simulation (ATOS).  The simulation supports research into next generation air traffic management technologies at NASA Langley and Ames Research Centers.  It consists of a scalable network of PC-based commercial aircraft simulations, each with a set of Boeing 777 cockpit panels and displays.  High Level Architecture (HLA) is used to tie the individual simulation components together, and allows ATOS to be connected to external air traffic control and other aircraft simulations.  The software is developed in Visual C++.
I accepted a supervisory roll over a team of 4 Software Developers and 1 Systems Administrator.
I was the lead engineer on the successful DIP-SOAR phase 1 feasibility study. I provided guidance to the DIP-SOAR team to create the necessary ASTOR framework to support the study.
I am responsible for software development and troubleshooting and test engineering across multiple NASA air traffic research projects and ATOS systems.

positions.description:

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Contracted to Boeing to remove and replace Boeing-proprietary network multicast, smoothing and Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) Protocol Data Unit (PDU) references from a Windows-based (C++) T-38 Instructor Operator Station (IOS).  Also tasked with developing a method to create missile tracking lines between the parent, missile and target entities on the F-15C IOS map display. This requires monitoring the simulator network for missile fire events and extracting fire PDU position data to connect the appropriate entities for the duration of the missile flight.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and integrated an After Action Review (AAR) system for a Windows-based (C/C++) MQ-1 Predator UAV Training System.  The AAR system utilized a Network Technologies, Inc. VEEMUX 16x16 Video Matrix Switch and Southern Vision Systems Video over IP transmitters, receivers, and Digital Video Recorders.  The AAR system allowed the Instructor/Operator to record and replay up to 4 instructor-designated synchronized real-time video outputs.  The IOS interface was designed to operate like a home DVR system with record, play, pause, and forward/rewind functions, and allowed the Instructor/Operator to play back the recorded video to multiple user selected displays.
Designed and implemented a Windows-based (C++/OpenGL) Heads-Up Display (HUD) for the MQ-1 Predator UAV Training System.  The display included gauges, flight displays and system messages.
Developed and fielded a low-cost COTS solution for a 16-station UAV simulator.  The solution saved the contract many thousands of dollars of development costs by utilizing COTS gaming Voice over IP software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and enhanced real-time software for rotary-wing flight simulators including A/MH-6M Little Bird, MH-47E/G, and MH-60K/L.  Designed, implemented, and tested software and hardware changes to correct existing defects and implement new requirements.  Coordinated with government personnel in prioritizing implementation of software changes.  Implemented  modifications to incorporate new functionality (electronic warfare, visual, and navigation systems) into existing simulations.  Responsibilities required developing software modules utilizing multiple programming languages (C, C++, FORTRAN) and operating systems (Windows 2000/XP and Redhat Linux).  Worked closely with Army Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure software enhancements and updates accurately model the operational characteristics of various aircraft systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced real-time software for rotary-wing flight simulators including A/MH-6M Little Bird, MH-47E/G, and MH-60K/L.  Designed, implemented, and tested software and hardware changes to correct existing defects and implement new requirements.  Coordinated with government personnel in prioritizing implementation of software changes.  Implemented  modifications to incorporate new functionality (electronic warfare, visual, and navigation systems) into existing simulations.  Responsibilities required developing software modules utilizing multiple programming languages (C, C++, FORTRAN) and operating systems (Windows 2000/XP and Redhat Linux)
Implemented a significant upgrade to the MH-47E and MH-60K Combat Mission Simulator (CMSs) Electronic Warfare (EW) suite by adding an AAR-47 missile warning simulation.  Assumed complete responsibility for this upgrade including avionics interface card specification, software development, and hardware/software integration.  Completed this modification on time under a very aggressive development schedule.
Participated in a major visual system upgrade to the MH-47E and MH-60K CMSs.  This upgrade involved replacing the existing Link image generators with CAE Medallion-S systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained real-time software for U.S. Air Force Special Operations fixed and rotary-wing flight simulators.  Implemented system modifications to incorporate new functionality (sound systems, navigation systems, etc.) into existing simulations.  Responsibilities required developing software modules utilizing multiple programming languages (C, C++, Ada, FORTRAN, Assembly)  and operating systems (Encore MPX and UNIX, Wind River VXWorks).  Worked closely with Air Force Subject Matter Experts (SME’s) to ensure software enhancements and updates accurately modeled the operational characteristics of various aircraft systems.
Configuration Data Management Engineer
Responsible for updating and maintaining software baselines for all site Aircrew Training Devices.  Developed Contractor Operating Instructions (COIs) and Engineering Instructions (EIs) to ensure the proper tracking of software changes and upgrades throughout the entire software life cycle. Responsible for ensuring software engineers followed proper software build submittal procedures to meet ISO 9001 requirements.  Developed numerous scripts (Encore JCL, UNIX awk/nawk, make and UNIX shell) to streamline and automate the software build process.
Senior Systems Engineer
Responsible for installation, modification, upgrade and maintenance of multiple embedded systems in a highly integrated real-time flight simulation environment.  Also responsible for technical research into new technologies for system upgrades and troubleshooting complex system problems.
Telemetry Systems Engineer
Responsible for system modification and software development and maintenance of a complex Automated Manufacturing, Test and Checkout System for the NASA Space Shuttle Atlantis.

positions.title: Senior Technical Representative
positions.description: Responsible for the installation, maintenance and upgrade of the entire Gould product line of real-time super mini-computers.  Also provided both hardware and software phone support to on- site customers and technical personnel.
